data.narrative: Completed Module 6 learning multi-layer bugs - chose vertical investigation strategy to trace requests through stack, diagnosed cascading failure (queue worker no backoff/no max retry exhausted shared connection pool causing API hang), fixed with exponential backoff, max retry count, and separate connection pools. Fixed duplicate analytics bug by separating cache key namespaces (redirect:link:<id> vs dedup:link:<id>).

dimension_scores.observation: Formed hypothesis for duplicate analytics bug targeting layer boundaries - queue worker cache dependency, analytics event duplication, cache key overlap. Hypothesis focused on interaction between cache invalidation fix and queue worker deduplication.
dimension_scores.evidence: module6_duplicate_analytics.md documents three hypotheses about queue worker cache dependency and key overlap

dimension_scores.observation: Used connection pool stats to identify 100% utilization as early detectable signal in cascading failure. Checked queue worker logs to understand retry behavior and connection acquisition patterns.
dimension_scores.evidence: module6_verification.md proposes connection pool utilization >80% alert as earliest detectable signal

dimension_scores.observation: Reproduced cascading failure by triggering queue job failure and observing connection pool exhaustion. Reproduced duplicate analytics by delete-recreate sequence with same short code. Verified fixes prevent both issues.
dimension_scores.evidence: module6_verification.md describes reproduction steps for both bugs

dimension_scores.observation: Module 6 did not exercise communication under pressure - this dimension was the focus of Module 05. Set baseline score as no evidence yet.
dimension_scores.evidence: No incident communication performed in Module 6 - focused on multi-layer debugging technique.

dimension_scores.observation: Traced cascading failure through 12-step causal chain from queue job failure to API down, identified systemic design flaws: no backoff, no max retry, shared connection pool (bulkheads principle). Traced duplicate analytics to shared cache key namespaces (hidden coupling between redirect cache and deduplication flag).
dimension_scores.evidence: module6_cascading_failure.md documents 12-step causal chain. module6_cache_namespace_fix.md explains shared key pattern as root cause.

dimension_scores.observation: Module 6 previewed postmortem concepts - the BREAK bug demonstrates how fixes can introduce new bugs (cache invalidation fix broke deduplication), which feeds into postmortem writing in Module 07. Set baseline score.
dimension_scores.evidence: module6_cache_namespace_fix.md explains how fix for Bug #9 created new bug due to shared keys

strengths: Chose vertical investigation strategy to reveal interaction failures between layers
Traced 12-step causal chain for cascading failure from queue job to API down
Implemented resource isolation with separate connection pools (bulkheads principle)
Fixed hidden coupling by separating cache key namespaces (redirect vs deduplication)
data.recommendation: Continue to Module 07 to develop postmortem quality skills - conducting blameless postmortems that identify systemic contributing factors and propose actionable remediation items with owners and deadlines.

public_evidence.artifact: Cascading failure fix with resource isolation
public_evidence.student_action: Diagnosed cascading failure where queue worker with no backoff/no max retry exhausted shared connection pool causing API hang. Fixed with exponential backoff (2^retry_count seconds), maximum retry count (5 then dead-letter queue), and separate connection pools for workers (3 connections) vs API (17 connections) using bulkheads principle.
public_evidence.technical_detail: Celery configuration with retry backoff, max_retries=5, dead-letter queue. Separate SQLAlchemy engines: api_engine with pool_size=17, worker_engine with pool_size=3
public_evidence.ability: Diagnosing and fixing cascading failures with resource isolation
public_evidence.reviewer_value: Demonstrates ability to trace causation across system layers, identify resource coupling points, and implement isolation patterns (bulkheads, backoff, retry limits) to prevent cascading failures

module6_cascading_failure.md describes separate connection pools for workers and API
module6_cache_namespace_fix.md explains redirect:link:<id> vs dedup:link:<id> prefixes

prefers systemic solutions (isolation) over symptom treatment (bigger pool)
